title: Don't reuse a Payables Agent user that has no permissions in the company
summary: Payables Agent setup now verifies that a reused agent user has permissions in the current company before attempting to reuse it, preventing task failures when a company is deleted and recreated with the same name.
key_points: Agent user lookup by name now includes a permissions check for the current company
If an agent user lacks permissions in the current company, a new agent is created instead of reused
Uses the same permissions verification the agent framework runs before accepting tasks
Agents already linked in company setup continue to work as before
Resolves task failures with 'agent has no access control permissions' error after company recreation
quote: The setup found it by that name and reused it, but its permissions belonged to the deleted company.
